_about: The 28 Named Legendaries (SPEC.md › Named Legendaries, plus The Croupier's Coat from the affix table's Unique row). Never rolled: generateLegendary(state, id) builds the item with four rolled affixes plus its unique. Numbers live in balance.json `legendaries.*`; `effect.params` names the KEYS, never the values. `effect.key` is what legendaryEffects[id] switches on and `effect.owner` says which module implements it: 'characters' (this module registers it in handlers/inventory.js), or 'items' | 'movement' | 'map' | 'encounters' | 'social' | 'modes' for effects that live where the mechanic lives; those are the documented stubs. `stakeKey` names the balance key for the item's stake (default items.stakeLegendary). Sprite key is legendary/<id>. Infernal Mantle opens the 16th slot `cape`.

legendaries.name: Pedestal Blade
legendaries.text: Cannot be drawn under level 10. At full Health, reach 3 instead of 1.

legendaries.name: Gravity Gauntlet
legendaries.text: Once per run, pull any player within 3 hexes onto your hex.

legendaries.name: Weighted Companion Pendant
legendaries.text: When you would die, the pendant is destroyed instead and you stay at 1 Health. It never says goodbye.

legendaries.name: Ember Flask
legendaries.text: Heals 30; refills to 3 charges at every Inn. Resting resets the region's monsters.

legendaries.name: Big Fancy Gun
legendaries.text: Stake 50; hits every player and monster on your hex and all six neighbours.

legendaries.name: Green-Cap Toadstool
legendaries.text: Eat it to bank an extra life: your next death costs no items and no turns.

legendaries.name: Oversized Buster Cleaver
legendaries.text: Stake 50, +50% damage, swings last in the turn because of the weight.

legendaries.name: Pip-Buoy
legendaries.text: Shows the exact Health of every player within 2 hexes, breaking the thirds tell.

legendaries.name: Tamer's Snare
legendaries.text: Throw at a monster under 25% Health to catch it as a pet instead of killing it.

legendaries.name: The Shout
legendaries.text: Push every adjacent player and monster 2 hexes away; stake 20.

legendaries.name: Blockbreaker Pick
legendaries.text: Walk through one void hex per turn; it is dug and stays open for everyone.

legendaries.name: Impostor's Visor
legendaries.text: Your letters cannot be intercepted, and for 2 turns the TV shows you as another player's sprite.

legendaries.name: The Joker
legendaries.text: Jokers count wild in your Video Poker hand; a five-of-a-kind is a double crit.

legendaries.name: Chicken Dinner Platter
legendaries.text: Only usable by the last player standing in Royale: heals to full and vaults an extra item.

legendaries.name: Rail Lance
legendaries.text: Lock on: name a target within 3 hexes; the next hit cannot miss (a loss becomes a push). Stake 35, one lock per fight.

legendaries.name: Corvette Broadside
legendaries.text: Fires a line: every player and monster in 3 hexes straight ahead takes the hit. Stake 50; so heavy you move 1 hex less while it is wielded.

legendaries.name: Octane Treads
legendaries.text: The movement wheel loses Stumble and gains two Boost 8 segments; ending your move next to a player bumps them 1 hex.

legendaries.name: Amulet of Potency
legendaries.text: +6% damage on every hit and +1 to all four stats. The plainest Legendary and the one everyone wants.

legendaries.name: Infernal Mantle
legendaries.text: Never dropped: awarded for clearing the deepest tier without dying. +3 Grit, immune to the Caldera's damage doubling, and the sprite burns.

legendaries.name: Deep-Sea Suit
legendaries.text: Water void hexes are passable for you; once per run you surface from one with a random Rare item.

legendaries.name: Skates of the Sixth
legendaries.text: Roll 2d6, but you cannot stop early and you slide one extra hex in your last direction.

legendaries.name: Spiny Blue Carapace
legendaries.text: Throw it: the player currently leading on score takes 30 wherever they are. Cannot be dodged; a Fork can split it.

legendaries.name: Clay Ocarina
legendaries.text: Three songs, each once per run: return to the last Inn you visited; skip the next Chaos turn; call a fainted pet back at 1 Power.

legendaries.name: Fairy in a Jar
legendaries.text: Sits in the grid. When you would die the jar breaks and you stand back up at 50% on the spot, no turns missed, no drops.

legendaries.name: Pool Ladder
legendaries.text: Place it on any hex to make it a pool; take the ladder away and whoever is in the pool cannot leave for 2 turns and loses 5 Health a turn. Put it back to let them out.

legendaries.name: Camera Obscura
legendaries.text: Three shots per run. A photo of a player reveals their exact Health and worn items to you; a photo of a revenant or wraith deals 15 and pins it for a turn.

legendaries.name: Reset Cartridge
legendaries.text: Resets your character to a clean state: clears every curse, pool, Blood Pact interest and Chaos effect on you and stands you on the last safe hex you visited. Also a GM console command for a stuck player.

legendaries.name: The Croupier's Coat
legendaries.text: Opponents must stake at least 20 against you.
